section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: 7 In the Union Territories, Delhi recorded a significant increase of 19.8% during 1970 over 1969 and this was contributed mostly by road and railway accidents. In the important Cities under study, Bangalore, Calcutta and Madras registered decreases, while all other Cities reported increases, the highest (52.5%) being in Bombay.
